summary: Public projects created on 1 November 2026: 2 repos.
intro: New repositories covered audio dataset preservation and mobile GitHub discovery, with a tool for archiving audio datasets into checksummed, disc-sized snapshots and an Android app for browsing topics, running advanced search operators, sorting results, and starring repos into Lists.

projects.name: Audio Dataset Backup
projects.description: Gathers Daniel's Hugging Face audio datasets into a pinned, checksummed, disc-sized point-in-time archive (M-DISC / cloud)

projects.name: GitHub Discovery
projects.description: Android app for discovering GitHub repos: browse topics, use desktop-grade advanced search operators on mobile, sort by newest or most starred, and star repos into Lists.
